BOX step 20a — Midland calibration cards: swap classes unlike their Delaware analogue (D134 B)

Built 2026-10-26T15:37:09-05:00, read-only. Classes are pooled per D19/D20 (WCA_1 + WCA_2 + WCXY = WCA; nothing is promoted into WCXY). Sample = 10 wells per class at evenly spaced quantiles of the margin ratio (own-band Δ ÷ suggested-band Δ; ∞ = own band absent), weakest flags first; classes of ≤ 12 are carded in full. Mark each card agree / reject (reply in chat by api10, or fill cards_sample.csv column verdict); a class is accepted or rejected wholesale on its precision. Star = subject; dots = wells within 1.5 mi coloured by tag, hollow = not clean evidence (planned survey, round TVD, < 6 mo, unmapped); dashed = coherent local band medians.
